## Mesure d'une caractéristique

![](../figure_elec_continu-1.png)

``` tex
\begin{tikzpicture}
        \draw (0,0) to[vsource=$E$] (0,2) to[rmeter, t=A] ++ (2,0) to[R={$R_L$}, i_=$I$] ++ (2,0) to[led, v=$U_L$] ++(0,-2) -- (0,0);
        \draw (4,1.8) -- (5.5,1.8) to[rmeter, t=V] (5.5,0.2) -- (4,0.2) ;
\end{tikzpicture}
```

![](../figure_elec_continu-2.png)

``` tex
\begin{tikzpicture}
        \draw (0,2) coordinate (EA1) node[left] {\textcolor{red}{SA1}} to[R, l_={$R_L$}, i_=$I$, *-*, v^={$U_R=\textcolor{C0}{EA1-EA5}$}] ++ (4,0) coordinate (EA5) coordinate (EA0) to[led, v^={$U_L=\textcolor{C2}{EA0}$}, *-] ++(0,-2) to[short, -*] (0,0) node[left] {GND} node[ground] {};
        
        \draw[-latex, thick, C0] (EA1) -- ++ (100: 0.75) node[above] {EA1};
        \draw[-latex, thick, C0] (EA5) -- ++ (80: 0.75) node[above] {EA5};

```


## Résistance de sortie d'un générateur

![](../figure_elec_continu-3.png)

``` tex
\begin{tikzpicture}
    \draw (0,0) to[vsource=$E$] (0,1) to[R=$r$] (0,2) -- (4,2) to[tgeneric=$R$, v=$U$] (4,0) -- (0,0) node[ground] {};
		\draw (4,2) -- (6,2) to[rmeter, t=V] (6,0) -- (4,0);
		\draw[dashed] (-1,0.1) rectangle (1,2.1);
		\path (-1,2.1) -- (1,2.1) node[midway, above] {Générateur};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
